highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.155.3 backports native security fixes and corrects Uno 6 WebAssembly linking on .NET 9 and later.
highlights_body: The servicing update keeps the 4.155 line available to Uno Platform 6 applications without changing public APIs or bindings.

bullets.detail: Adds 25 CVE fixes and 13 further hardening and test fixes to the 4.155 native engine. The changes address shader-pipeline validation, GPU uploads and resource state, texture sampling, glyph bounds, and allocation arithmetic, complementing earlier security backports on this line.

bullets.lead: Uno 6 WebAssembly linking on newer .NET targets
bullets.detail: Uno 6.x applications using the Skia renderer no longer receive the conflicting -sUSE_WEBGPU linker option on .NET 9 and later, where Dawn supplies WebGPU. The option remains enabled for net8.0, which still uses Emscripten's built-in WebGPU port.

The backport also prevents unwritten scratch-texture contents from entering filtered output and corrects glyph-copy bounds. It resets Graphite depth tracking after overwriting draws to preserve painter order.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Backported Skia security and rendering fixes and corrected Uno 6 WebAssembly linker options.
